dialogues.speaker: Afanasi
dialogues.text: An inspection today, and tomorrow too... Why is there one every day?

dialogues.speaker: Afanasi
dialogues.text: Me? I'm okay. I'm holding up.

dialogues.speaker: Afanasi
dialogues.text: I don't know why, but the port inspectors have been checking my goods every day.

dialogues.speaker: Afanasi
dialogues.text: What I'm selling is clearly ordinary Snezhnayan industrial goods though.

dialogues.speaker: Afanasi
dialogues.text: But these inspectors seem to be always on edge, as if they are afraid of my wares exploding all of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Afanasi
dialogues.text: Ah, I wish they would relax. These constant investigations will affect my business...

dialogues.speaker: Afanasi
dialogues.text: When will they leave me alone...?
